name: smwmusic-ys-iv-the-dawn-of-ys-theme-of-adol
title: Ys IV: The Dawn of Ys - Theme of Adol 1993
description:
Adol Christin's theme song from Ys IV. This song is used as one of dungeon themes in both Ys IV: The Dawn of Ys on the TurboGrafx-CD and Ys IV: Mask of the Sun on the SNES. This song didn't return in the remake Ys: Memories of Celceta.

This port is based on the original FM music by Falcom's composer Naoki Kaneda listed in the 1993 album Ys IV J.D.K. Special The Dawn of Ys. This version was arranged by Ryo Yonemitsu for the TurboGrafx-CD version.
